question: How many countries are there in the graph?
Which country exports the most memory chips, and how much?
gold:
PREFIX ul: <https://ul.edu.lb/kr/scm#>
SELECT ?country (SUM(?v) AS ?totalUsd)
WHERE { ?t ul:exportedBy ?c ; ul:hasTier <https://ul.edu.lb/kr/id/tier/Tier_3B_Memory> ; ul:tradeValueUsd ?v . ?c ul:name ?country }
GROUP BY ?country ORDER BY DESC(?totalUsd) LIMIT 1

question: How many different countries import logic processors?
What is the total value of all wafer trade?
Which tiers does the wafer tier feed directly?
Which surplus countries have a net trade balance above 1 billion USD?
gold:
PREFIX ul: <https://ul.edu.lb/kr/scm#>
SELECT ?country ?balance
WHERE {
  ?c a ul:SurplusCountry ; ul:name ?country ; ul:netTradeBalanceUsd ?balance .
  FILTER(?balance > 1000000000)
}
ORDER BY DESC(?balance)

question: What is the strategic bottleneck of the equipment tier?
How much did China export in total?
Which country imports the most memory chips from China?
gold:
PREFIX ul: <https://ul.edu.lb/kr/scm#>
SELECT ?country (SUM(?v) AS ?totalUsd)
WHERE {
  ?t ul:exportedBy ?e ; ul:importedBy ?i ; ul:hasTier <https://ul.edu.lb/kr/id/tier/Tier_3B_Memory> ; ul:tradeValueUsd ?v .
  ?e ul:name ?en . ?i ul:name ?country .
  FILTER(LCASE(STR(?en)) = "china")
}
GROUP BY ?country ORDER BY DESC(?totalUsd) LIMIT 1

question: Which tier has the largest total trade value?
gold:
PREFIX ul: <https://ul.edu.lb/kr/scm#>
SELECT ?tier (SUM(?v) AS ?totalUsd)
WHERE { ?t ul:hasTier ?h ; ul:tradeValueUsd ?v . BIND(REPLACE(STR(?h), "^.*/", "") AS ?tier) }
GROUP BY ?tier ORDER BY DESC(?totalUsd) LIMIT 1
